not_rules.note: G-1: Section heading.
Describes script layout conventions for voice actors.
not_rules.quote:
Scripts provide clear directions for speakers about emphasis and pronunciation. When printed or displayed, scripts use:
[a8dadd001003] a plain font
[90b0c92b09f0] wide line spacing
[97bf30567047] white space
[0eaf99382890] short paragraphs
[4f2f81acca2e] short sentences and some longer sentences to reflect speech patterns
[fd3f78ca6c73] markers for brief pauses throughout to help speakers breathe and listeners think

covers.quote: Create accessible video and audio with the correct alternative versions so everyone can access the information.
Use the script as the basis for the text version (media alternative) for the recording to meet accessibility and SEO requirements.

rules.quote: Provide a text alternative to video and audio
rules.violation_condition: a video or audio file published without an accompanying text alternative or transcript
rules.why: G-2, G-4: Core accessibility requirement across media formats; restatements consolidated into main rule.

covers.quote: Videos covering complex topics and hosted on your organisation’s website can be longer.

rules.quote: They should be be no more than one to 2 minutes long, especially if you share the video on social media.
rules.violation_condition: an online video that exceeds 2 minutes in duration
when: Videos covering complex topics and hosted on an organisation's website can be longer.
rules.why: G-2, G-3: Direct guideline on video length with specific exception for complex topics hosted on websites.

rules.quote:
Break the video into smaller, stand-alone pieces if:
[abca1c74546b] the message is complex
[183ad6e26538] there is more than one message.
rules.violation_condition: a single video that covers complex subject matter or multiple distinct messages without being split into stand-alone segments
when: The message is complex or contains more than one message.
rules.why: G-2: Conditional rule for chunking video content.

covers.quote: When using text or images of text in animation, meet minimum requirements for colour contrast.

rules.quote: Ensure colour is not the only means of conveying meaning.
rules.violation_condition: colour used as the only visual means of conveying information, indicating an action, prompting a response, or distinguishing a visual element
rules.why: G-2: Standard accessibility rule applied to video/animation.

rules.quote: Include live captioning in synchronised media for live broadcasts to ensure content is available to all users.
rules.violation_condition: a live broadcast with synchronised audio/video that does not provide live captioning

rules.quote: Ensure audio and supporting text use inclusive language.
rules.violation_condition: audio or supporting text that uses exclusionary, biased, or non-inclusive language
rules.why: G-2: Core style requirement for language in scripts and audio.

covers.quote: Don’t over-simplify to the point where you lose meaning and people feel patronised.

rules.quote: Use simple language and a conversational tone, and avoid jargon.
rules.violation_condition: audio-only content containing overly complex language, bureaucratic jargon, or a stiff tone
rules.why: G-2, G-4: Tone and register guidance for audio.

rules.quote: speech is at a rate of between 130 and 170 words per minute.
rules.violation_condition: spoken audio or narration recorded at a speaking rate slower than 130 words per minute or faster than 170 words per minute
